context.objective: Record how workshop waivers are filed.

turns.text: I am the registrar. I prepare a waiver for each workshop.
What do you do after preparing the waiver?

The instructor signs the waiver. Once the instructor signs, I file the signed waiver in the green binder. The instructor keeps the room schedule. We used to use a blue binder. Next year we may switch to digital filing.
